blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `verifyAuthMfa` method. This belongs to the Auth Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method verifies a pending multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup.

types.name: data
types.description: The verification data including multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration ID and code.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration to verify.

children.name: auth_identity_id
children.description: The ID of the authentication identity this multi-factor authentication (MFA) belongs to.

children.name: code
children.description: The verification code from the multi-factor authentication (MFA) provider.
